## Goal
Explain in plain words how to make the screen bigger and have it read aloud, step by step, with what to do when there is no sound. Builds on the existing page for larger text, dark mode and zoom (WO-317) and does not repeat it: link to it for the parts already covered.

## Blocked: what in-house must provide first
In-house must ship read-aloud (ROADMAP 0.4 order item 2) and the full-wizard large-text pass, and provide the control labels with file:line, which keys or buttons start and stop reading, which voices are used on Windows 10 and Windows 11, whether it works offline, and the known limits. Do not describe a voice or a shortcut that is not in the build.

Not startable by a vendor. In-house unblocks it by changing the status line and posting a GO.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. Under 450 words, reading level grade 8 or lower, one action per step.
2. Every control named exists in the app with file:line in an HTML comment.
3. Covers: turn it on, turn it off, pause, what to check when there is no sound (volume, device), and that it works without the internet (only if in-house confirms).
4. Links to the WO-317 page for text size and zoom instead of repeating it.
5. No promise of voices, languages or accuracy that the build does not give.
6. Forbidden-words check passes.

**Limits (every Grok WO, CLAUDE-G-004):** offline only. No network, credentials, git or gh, installs, or running the real app against real sites or a real mailbox; never read anything outside the repo. Fake people only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Tests pass on Windows too (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`). Check `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/`, `tests/grok/` and the in-house `tests/test_*.py` first; don't duplicate a guard.
